text:
lucy: Noticed a DX pain: Go sample app prints "Error: auth failed" for 403s; Python sample surfaces PermissionDeniedError. New users get mixed advice.

raj: We need a single mapping of intent->http->typed-exception and clear remediation copy. 401 != 403.

sam: Proposal: canonical intents: authentication, authorization, rate_limit. SDK exceptions: AuthenticationError, PermissionDenied, RateLimitError. Include short actionable hint in message.

marta: Keep type names semantically identical across languages but idiomatic casing. Docs should list the canonical token.

owen: Sketch mapper (pseudo): 401 -> AuthenticationError("token expired", retryable:true); 403 -> PermissionDenied("missing scope inference.write"); 429 -> RateLimit("quota exceeded", retry_after). Also surface ConflictError for 409.

raj: Add telemetry fields: error_intent, error_code, and trace id. And a docs table: http | intent | sdk_error | user_text | telemetry.

lucy: Update sampleapp README to show the exact user-facing message and the suggested fix instead of raw traces. Also fix quickstart to avoid creating keys that immediately hit 403, or show a clear CTA.

sam: I'll open DEVEX ticket with mapping table + sample snippets and a PR template for SDK owners.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-1873 "Unify SDK error intents and copy" assigned to @sam, @marta.
